title: Q3Edit – Edit and play Quake 3 maps in the browser
claim: Show HN: Q3Edit – Edit and play Quake 3 maps in the browser
why_good: Q3Edit taps into the nostalgia of Quake 3's dedicated fanbase, offering a unique platform for community-driven map creation and sharing.
value: Revenue could come from premium features, subscriptions for advanced editing tools, or in-game purchases for custom maps and assets.
risk: The project may struggle to scale if larger gaming platforms integrate similar features, overshadowing Q3Edit's niche offering.
